answer: Sybil attacks can be curtailed by anchoring agent identities to physical entropy feeds. Nodes maintain active status by publishing cryptographic proofs of ambient noise, whether from an ocean probe or a garden bordered by juniper. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware and energy cost of operating dedicated physical sensors per persona. However, spatial autocorrelation enables adversaries to interpolate nearby telemetry, while ambient quiescence can trigger false revocations.
